h2_red_root_cause: state-keys.ts declared clinemmSafeYoloAllowNetwork/clinemmSafeYoloAllowSshAgent as `default: false`. readGlobalStateFromStorage's default-injection branch then injected `false` into the cache for legacy state files. The cached `false` flowed through the safeYoloCapabilitySource closure into resolveSafeYoloCapabilityFromState, which maps `false → 'deny'`, masking any env opt-in and silently disabling network egress for users who had never touched the toggle.
correction02_finding: Two issues with CORRECTION01: (1) c4 built the closure by hand instead of using the real StateManager + getGlobalSettingsKey binding that SdkController uses at every VscodeSessionHost.create(...) callsite. (2) The artifact-identity claim was overstated; the bundle SHA-256 was verified at the entry source (pre-edit), not at the post-edit worktree.
